title: Bihar Assembly winning MLAs average declared assets
definition: Mean total declared assets of all winning candidates in Bihar Legislative Assembly elections (241 analysed in 2020; all 243 in 2025) from sworn ECI affidavits compiled by ADR and Bihar Election Watch.

sources.publisher: Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR) and Bihar Election Watch
sources.title: Analysis of Criminal Background, Financial, Education, Gender and other details of Winning Candidates in Bihar Assembly Election 2025

points.evidence: The average of assets per MLA in the Bihar Assembly Elections 2020 was Rs 4.32 crore (194 of 241 MLAs, or 81%, were crorepati).
Average Assets: The average of assets per winning candidates in the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025 is Rs 9.02 Crores (total Rs 2,192.93 Crores across 243 winners; 218 or 90% crorepatis).
